title: L0177
description: Output of an L0177 program — a structural PROOF that the described authoring-integration operation's request constructs and signs correctly. This is NOT the deliverable; the developer-facing recipe is produced by get_spec. Atomic dialect (not a composition upstream).

verified.description: True when the operation and its parameters validated and the request was structurally constructed.

signed.description: True when the request was locally HMAC-signed as a structural check (no network call).

signedWithRealCredentials.description: True when the caller supplied their own learnosity-key/secret (vs. a placeholder used only to exercise signing).
